Add a styled basemap layer to a ggplot2 spatial plot.

Source: R/geom_basemap.R
geom_basemap.Rd

Wraps a lazy GeomBasemap ggproto layer that defers tile fetching until coord_sf() has established the panel's geographic extent.

Usage

geom_basemap(
  style,
  tile_zoom = NULL,
  alpha = 1,
  layers = NULL,
  labels = TRUE,
  features = NULL,
  pixel_ratio = NULL,
  auth_token = NULL,
  tile_timeout_ms = 10000L,
  max_tiles = 256L,
  attribution = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

style

A MapLibre GL style URL or JSON string (e.g. from basemap_provider()), or a vector / list of styles stacked bottom to top.

tile_zoom

Tile detail override: the tile zoom on the 256 px grid (vector sources use one less, their tiles being 512 px), or NULL to pick tiles as MapLibre does for the view.

alpha

Opacity of the basemap layer (0–1).

layers

Optional layer filter applied to every style: plain IDs keep only those layers, minus-prefixed IDs drop them; * and ? are wildcards ("-label_*"). See list_layers(). Names that match no layer of any style warn.

labels

TRUE keeps every layer, FALSE drops the labels (text and icons), "only" keeps only the labels on a transparent background, to stack over another map. Catalogue raster basemaps switch to their label-free or label-only tiles.

features

Optional feature filter applied to every style: plain names keep those features, minus-prefixed names drop them, e.g. c("water", "roads") or "-buildings". Features: background, water, landcover, parks, buildings, roads, rail, boundaries, places, poi, terrain, other (the feature column of list_layers()). Features no layer of any style belongs to warn.

pixel_ratio

Device pixels per CSS pixel (MapLibre's devicePixelRatio). Default: device dpi / 96, so lines and labels keep their physical size at any resolution. Larger values draw map symbols smaller.

auth_token

Optional access token for the tile service.

tile_timeout_ms

Per-tile HTTP timeout in milliseconds.

max_tiles

Maximum tiles fetched per style.

attribution

The credit line the basemap's providers ask for, drawn small in the bottom-right corner of each panel: TRUE (the default) for the styles' own (see get_attribution()), FALSE for none, or your own text. It is drawn with the basemap, so later layers can cover it.

...

Additional arguments passed to ggplot2::layer().

Value

A ggplot2 layer object.

Details

The basemap is rendered when the plot is drawn, for the panel's size at the device's resolution: ggsave(dpi = 300) gets a basemap rendered natively at 300 dpi (and PDF / SVG output at 300 dpi), not an upscaled screen image. Python (plotnine): basemapper.geom_basemap(), with the same arguments.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
nc <- st_read(system.file("shape/nc.shp", package = "sf"), quiet = TRUE)
ggplot(nc) +
  geom_basemap("OpenFreeMap.Positron") +
  geom_sf(fill = NA, color = "steelblue") +
  coord_sf()
} # }
